Porch Light Moth Maze

Steer the moth through the porch maze. Collect 6 nectar sparks, then escape through the screen door.

Avoid the brightest bulbs. Their glow pulls you in and traps careless moths.

Keyboard: arrows or WASD. Touch: hold a direction. Collect sparks, dodge bright bulbs, escape.
